thread:
marta: quick ping — noticed a tiny quota blip during the EU canary. looks like proxy preflight and runtime resume both charged for the same reconnect.
liam: saw it too, ~03:22 UTC. two keepalive increments, 400ms apart. console fired an alert.
arjun: probable cause: proxy emits keepalive without flow_id, runtime emits keepalive with flow_id on resume -> console can't dedupe.
kat: simple short-term fix: add X-Keepalive-Origin: proxy header and make collector treat origin=proxy events as provisional for 250ms before finalizing charge.
marta: can we do that without losing charges when resume never arrives?
arjun: yes — finalize immediately if no resume within 250ms. we only delay when origin=proxy to collapse dupes.
liam: telemetry change: add keepalive_origin and keepalive_status (PROVISIONAL|FINAL). console can suppress alerts for spikes dominated by PROVISIONAL events.
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary started for arjun/keepalive-origin-flag (build #7201).
console-bot: muting alert-group quota-stream-canary while backfill runs.
arjun: will open PRs: header+buffer + console suppression rule + backfill job. unit tests to cover race.
marta: thanks — if canary stable for 30m we'll promote and run backfill. I'll file the retro note.
